extracted.intended_audience: systems researchers and practitioners submitting papers to or attending OSDI '26 (academic and industrial)
extracted.subtask_description: High-level conference page describing OSDI '26 aims, topical scope, program/committees, deadlines, and related policies; useful for authors deciding fit and preparing submissions. Emphasizes the kinds of contributions the symposium seeks and notes artifact evaluation and policy links.

rubrics_metrics.name: Emphasis on innovative research
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Page statement indicates submissions should foreground novelty/innovation in systems research. No detailed scoring guidance is provided on the page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Emphasis on quantified or insightful experiences
rubrics_metrics.description: "...as well as quantified or insightful experiences in systems design and implementation."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: In addition to novel technical research, OSDI solicits papers that report measured (quantified) results or provide insightful experiential learnings about building systems. The page does not supply explicit evaluation rubrics for these experiential submissions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Topical scope: design, implementation, and implications of systems software
rubrics_metrics.description: "OSDI brings together professionals ... for discussing the design, implementation, and implications of systems software."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submissions should fit within the conference's stated topical scope — work about design, implementation, or implications of systems software. The page lists this scope as the primary subject area but gives no further topic granularity or exclusion list.

rubrics_metrics.name: Artifact evaluation process (presence of an Artifact Evaluation Committee)
rubrics_metrics.description: The page lists an "Artifact Evaluation Committee" and co-chairs, indicating a formal artifact-evaluation track or process associated with the symposium.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authors whose submissions include artifacts (code, data, reproducibility packages) should expect an artifact evaluation; specifics (criteria, badges, submission requirements) are not included on this page and would be found on the artifact-evaluation or author instructions pages.

rubrics_metrics.name: Adherence to conference policies and Code of Conduct
rubrics_metrics.description: Links on the page point to "Conference Policies" and a "Code of Conduct."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Attendees and authors are required to follow conference policies and the Code of Conduct. The page also provides accessibility request deadlines (requests by Monday, June 22, 2026) and contact emails for various queries; detailed behavioral and policy rules are on the linked pages (not expanded here).
